## About
Payes Automotive is a fully equipped repair shop on W Deer Valley Rd in Phoenix, serving the greater Phoenix metro. We look after people's own cars and trucks, and their work and fleet vehicles too.
Every job starts with finding out what is actually causing the problem. From there, Kevin and his team handle the repair, whether that's brakes, A/C, cooling systems, alignment, transmission or getting a car through emissions.
We also love the custom side of the work. Classic restorations, lift kits, lowering and power boosts all come through our shop.

## Services
- Diagnostics: We start by finding out what is causing the problem before any repair work begins.
- Auto repair: Everyday repair work from trained, ASE certified mechanics.
- Emissions: Help getting your vehicle through emissions. One reviewer said the team got their kid's car through.
- Restoration: Classic restoration projects handled by people who really love cars.
- Lift kits and power boosts: Lift kits, power boosts and other custom work to get you driving the car you want.
- Work and fleet vehicles: We look after work trucks and fleet vehicles as well as personal cars.
